hero.heading: Yummy, challenging, feel-good Pilates

Join me in building strength, awakening flexibility, and moving through life with more freedom and ease.

about.heading: Strengthen. Stretch. Savor.
paragraphs: Relish Pilates is all about sharing movement as a powerful and nourishing way to connect to yourself.
With a personal guide designing, leading and adapting your workout as you move, you get the most out of every moment.
And you can have some time that's truly all about you, what you want for your body and how you want to feel in it.

faqPage.metadataDescription: Find answers to common questions about Relish Pilates sessions and scheduling.
faqPage.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

items.title: What is Pilates?
items.body: Pilates is a low-impact exercise method that focuses on building strength, flexibility, and body awareness through controlled movements.

items.title: Do I need experience?
items.body: No experience necessary. Our sessions are customized to your level and goals, whether you're a beginner or advanced practitioner.

privacyPage.metadataDescription: Relish Pilates privacy policy and data protection information.
privacyPage.heading: Privacy Policy

items.title: Information We Collect
items.body: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you book a session or fill out our contact form. This includes your name, email address, and any fitness information relevant to your Pilates sessions.

items.title: How We Use Your Information
items.body: We use your information to provide and improve our services, communicate with you about your sessions, and send you updates about new offerings. We never share your personal information with third parties without your consent.

items.title: Data Security
items.body: We take data security seriously and implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

items.title: Your Rights
items.body: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information at any time. If you have questions about how we handle your data, please contact us at our email or phone number listed on our website.

items.title: Cookies and Tracking
items.body: Our website may use cookies to improve your user experience. These are small files stored on your device that help us understand how you interact with our site. You can disable cookies in your browser settings if you prefer.

items.title: Changes to This Policy
items.body: We may update this privacy policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the updated policy on our website.

termsPage.metadataDescription: Relish Pilates terms of service and conditions for using our platform.
termsPage.heading: Terms of Service

items.title: Acceptance of Terms
items.body: By booking a session or using our website, you agree to these terms and conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you may not use our services.

items.title: Session Cancellation & Rescheduling
items.body: You may reschedule or cancel your session with at least 24 hours notice. Cancellations made less than 24 hours before your scheduled session may result in forfeiture of that session. No refunds are provided for cancellations outside the rescheduling window.

items.title: Session Packages
items.body: Session packages expire 6 months from the purchase date. Unused sessions after the expiration date will be forfeited. Session pricing does not include applicable taxes. All prices are subject to change without notice.

items.title: Assumption of Risk
items.body: Pilates is a physical activity. You acknowledge that participating in our sessions involves inherent risks. You assume all risks associated with your participation and agree to release Relish Pilates from any liability for injuries or damages.

items.title: Medical Consultation
items.body: Before starting any new exercise program, including Pilates, consult with a healthcare professional if you have any pre-existing medical conditions, injuries, or concerns. Relish Pilates is not a substitute for medical advice.

items.title: Liability Limitation
items.body: Relish Pilates shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of our services. Our liability is limited to the amount you paid for your sessions.

items.title: User Conduct
items.body: You agree to use our services in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations. You will not engage in any conduct that is harmful, threatening, abusive, or otherwise violates the rights of others.

items.title: Changes to Terms
items.body: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting to our website. Your continued use of our services constitutes acceptance of any modifications.
